c2pa.description: The app.zeens.c2pa#credential entries, if any, written as that record's images at publish time.

meta.description: The app.zeens.postMeta record body, if any. post and createdAt are replaced at publish time.

post.description: The post record body. createdAt is replaced with the publish time.

rkey.description: The rkey the post and its postMeta are written at. Minted at scheduling time so a cross-link URL in the caption is correct in advance, and so publishing twice fails instead of posting twice.

publishAt.description: When to publish. The worker reads this from the record at publish time, so editing it here is how a post is rescheduled.

collection.description: Where the post is written: Bluesky, or Zeens-only.

collections.description: Collections the post joins once it exists. Each item's rkey is minted at scheduling time so adding it is idempotent.

main.description: A post waiting to be published. Holds the finished post record and its postMeta exactly as they will be written, so publishing is a copy and nothing is recomputed. Lives on the author's own PDS rather than on Zeens' servers; the images are uploaded at scheduling time and this record keeps them referenced until publish. NOT PRIVATE: like every repo record it is publicly readable before publishAt. Deliberately absent from the AppView's lexicons and firehose collections, so it is never indexed as content.

rkey.description: The rkey the app.zeens.collectionItem is written at.
